messages:
Samir: Heads up — I'm seeing a recurring 'flicker' pattern from the DCGM exporter in us-west-2. Xid spikes that clear in <30s but correlate with a small temp/IO blip. Examples: gpu-node-12 card0, gpu-node-77 card2. Not sure if HW or a perf job. :thinking_face:
Maria: saw something similar in eu-west-1 yesterday on rack-3. Bursts every 6–8h, short lived. Paging noise last time, we should avoid a repeat.
Zheng: can you paste the offending alert rule? current rule is too chatty, we used increase(...[1m]) elsewhere which picks up transient blips.
Samir: current rule snippet we have (too sensitive):
```
alert: GPU_ECC_XID_Errors
expr: increase(dcgm_xid_errors_total[1m]) > 0
for: 0m
labels:
  severity: page
```
Proposed fusion approach (rough):
```
# fire if multiple xid/ecc events AND temp/telemetry also abnormal OR sustained over 10m
expr: (
  increase(dcgm_xid_errors_total[5m]) > 2
  and max_over_time(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{job="dcgm-exporter"}[5m]) > 75
)
or
(increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[5m]) > 3)
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: warning
```
The idea is: require either a multi-event burst correlated with temp or a sustained ECC ramp. Also add label-based filtering so only A100/V100 series escalate to page, older cards go to ticket.
Elin: I like adding the for:10m and temperature gating. Also suggest adding a 'card_count' condition so we only page if >2 cards in the same node/rack. Otherwise route to infra-ops (non-pager).
Maria: we also need Alertmanager inhibit/grouping to prevent flood — last time a single transient caused 40 pages. Group by cluster/instance and add a mute window for severity=warning -> ticket. After we tweak rules, let's run a chaosmonkey-style test to ensure we don't miss regressions.
Zheng: @oncall-bot run-collector-check gpu-node-12,gpu-node-77 please
oncall-bot: collector-check started for gpu-node-12,gpu-node-77. logs: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/2812345678/collector.log :gear:
Elin: ack, I'll keep an eye on the dashboard and mute noisy alerts in the temp channel if we see spikes. If a card repeats 3x in 30d we RMA.
Samir: I'll open a PR with the rule changes + alertmanager inhibits and routing. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-config/pull/987 — includes routing logic: page only when (cards_in_node > 2 OR sustained_ecc > 3 in 10m). Rolling deploy scheduled for us-west-2 02:00 UTC tomorrow.
Maria: nice. After rollout, runbook update needed: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-flicker — add steps for fingerprinting noisy cards (collect nvml logs, hwmon, process list).
Zheng: sounds good. One more note: exporter v1.4.2 had a noisy histogram for ECC count; if we still see chatter, pin exporter to 1.4.1 for that fleet and open a debug issue with NVIDIA telemetry team.
Samir: agreed. Plan: PR+inhibit rules -> dry-run in staging -> roll to us-west-2 -> chaos test -> update runbook. Will post final rollout notes here. :thumbsup:
